trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a lump sum under the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit for listed injuries occurring within 180 days of an accident, with cover to age 76 for applicants aged 18-65.

keyFigures.label: Claim window
keyFigures.condition: injury listed in the benefit schedule

exclusionsOrConditions: Benefit is payable only for injuries listed in the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit Schedule.
The injury must occur within 180 days of the accident.
Once 100% of the sum assured is paid, the policy ends.
clientSignalPhrases: wants a lump sum for the family
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail} who supports the family, the plan pays a lump sum for accidental death or dismemberment and stays in force to age 76.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the sum assured options and per-life maximum.
Confirm the benefit schedule percentages for each listed injury.
sourceEvidence: Benefit Term Up to the age of 76
we will pay a lump sum benefit according to the Benefit Schedule for the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit
trends.notesForReviewer: Brochure text is for the combined Super Shield series and is truncated; benefit schedule and sum assured options are missing.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays 1% of the sum assured monthly from the 7th month for up to 100 months while permanent total disability continues after 6 consecutive months.

keyFigures.label: Qualifying period
keyFigures.condition: totally and permanently disabled within 180 days of accident

exclusionsOrConditions: Disability must arise within 180 days of the accident and persist 6 consecutive months.
Permanent Total Disability Benefit is not paid after the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit has been paid, and vice versa.
clientSignalPhrases: wants support if he can't work
negativeSignalPhrases: wants a one-off lump sum only
trends.talkingPointTemplate: If {client_detail} is permanently disabled after an accident, the plan pays 1% of the sum assured every month for up to 100 months.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the definition of total and permanent disability.
Confirm how the disability benefit reduces the remaining sum assured.
sourceEvidence: the insured will receive a monthly payment equal to 1% of the sum assured beginning from the 7th month and continuing up to 100 months (while disability continues)
trends.notesForReviewer: No income test or occupational class detail in the excerpt.

trends.whatProductOffers: Reimburses reasonable and customary medical expenses incurred within 52 weeks of an accident, up to the maximum limit per accident.

keyFigures.label: Limit
keyFigures.value: Maximum limit per accident per insured
keyFigures.condition: amount per benefits schedule, not stated

exclusionsOrConditions: Reimbursement is capped per accident; the actual amount is not in the source.
Expenses must be reasonable and customary.
clientSignalPhrases: had a bad fall last year
wants both lump sum and bills
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail} with no hospital plan, accident medical bills are reimbursed for treatment within 52 weeks, on top of the lump-sum benefits.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the per-accident maximum in the benefits schedule.
Confirm whether the medical reimbursement reduces the sum assured.
sourceEvidence: we will reimburse the reasonable and customary medical expenses incurred within 52 weeks after the accident, up to the maximum limit per accident for the insured
trends.notesForReviewer: The per-accident maximum is not stated in the supplied text.

trends.whatProductOffers: Adds psychological counselling services after a covered accident, a Well Being Program and 24-hour worldwide emergency assistance up to HK$/MOP5,000,000 per life.

keyFigures.label: Emergency assistance
keyFigures.condition: aggregate across AIA policies on the same insured

exclusionsOrConditions: The assistance limit is shared across all AIA policies covering the same insured.
Counselling amount is per the benefits schedule, not stated in the source.
Available to permanent residents of Hong Kong or Macau for the assistance service.
clientProfileFit: Clients wanting accident support services, not just payout
Workers in high-stress or high-risk jobs
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the plan adds psychological counselling after an accident and a 24-hour worldwide assistance line, not just a cash payout.

Confirm what the Well Being Program includes for this plan.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: An accident plan for ages 18-65 with death and dismemberment cover to age 76, monthly disability income and accident medical reimbursement.
notSuitedWhen: The client is outside the 18-65 application age
The client needs illness or critical illness cover
The client wants cashless hospital admission
